home.bio: Hello, World! I'm a Software Engineer focused on turning ideas into reality by building reliable, scalable, and custom-made applications with AI-powered tools.

skills.title: Technical Expertise
skills.description1: I'm currently building robust software infrastructures that scale. My approach combines clean code principles, full type safety, and AI-assisted workflows with a relentless focus on the end-user experience.
skills.description2: An overview of the technologies, frameworks, and tools I use to build end-to-end applications.

fullstack.title: Full-Stack Software Engineering
fullstack.description: Designing and building end-to-end software solutions by combining clean code, design patterns, modern frontend interfaces, and scalable backend architectures.

database.title: Database Systems & Data Modeling
database.description: Designing, modeling, and managing relational (SQL) and NoSQL databases, focusing on data integrity, efficient indexing, and ORM integration.

architecture.title: Software Architecture
architecture.description: Designing and implementing scalable software solutions with a focus on maintainability, SOLID principles, and system performance.

testing.title: Automated Testing
testing.description: Writing and maintaining tests to ensure code quality and reliability with unit, integration, and E2E testing strategies.

uiux.title: UI/UX Design & Styling
uiux.description: Creating beautiful and functional user interfaces with a focus on usability, accessibility, and modern aesthetics.

ai.title: AI-Assisted Development
ai.description: Leveraging AI tools such as ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenCode and techniques to enhance the development process, from code generation to automated testing and optimization.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of my recent engineering challenges and solutions.

habitTrack.description: A habit-tracking application designed to help users build consistency through daily check-ins, visual stats, and localized persistent data logic.

quintoSet.description: Platform for the Quinto Set social volleyball school in Cesarão with free enrollment, lead management and admin panel with 15-min inactivity security.

vaultEngine.description: A robust API for data control and authentication.

overmatch.description: An institutional landing page built for an English learning academy, featuring course previews, modern layout structuring, and fast performance.
